verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Superset offering its own mechanism for adding a codebase-conventions context file that shapes agent plans or code. The closest items don't count: project setup/teardown scripts, Superset-provided skills (`computer`, `superset:orchestrate`), and the site's own agents.md are adjacent features, and any context-file support inside the wrapped CLI agents belongs to those agents, not Superset.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code
